metadata.Quality: low, medium, high, xhigh, max, auto

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate or edit

images.description: Input images for image editing, 1-16 entries. Each entry is base64-encoded (raw string or data:image/{png|jpeg|webp};base64,... URI).

size.description: Size of the generated image. For gif output, the size of each frame.

background.description: Background transparency setting. Use transparent for images with no background, opaque for a solid background, or auto to let the model decide.

output_format.description: Output format for the generated image. Use gif for an animated GIF.

moderation.description: Content moderation level. Use low for less restrictive filtering, or auto for the default.

output_compression.description: Compression level from 0 to 100 for webp and jpeg output

complexity.description: How much the model plans the image before it renders it, separately from quality

frame_count.description: Number of frames, from 2 to 16, for gif output

frame_duration_ms.description: Delay per frame in milliseconds, at least 20, for gif output
